newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa started as sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa started as sell.

text.p: -- ING Barings said in a report that it is initiating coverage of Brazilian steelmaker Cosipa with a sell recommendation.
-- The Dutch investment bank said the company's current investment is expected to improve product quality and reduce production costs.
-- However, Cosipa's debt burden should continue to jeopardize profits through 1998, it added.
-- Also, "competition with CST in the hot-rolled segment and with CSN and Usiminas in the cold-rolled segment limits Cosipa's domestic market share," the bank said.
-- It added that a 25-percent overhang on the price of its preferred share and 15-percent overhang on its common will limit Cosipa's stock performance over the next 12 months.
-- Cosipa's preferred B share was flat at Friday's closing price of 0.83 reais at 1247 local/1447 GMT on the Sao Paulo stock market. Its common was unchanged at 0.72 reais.
